fullPassage: Architects are ambivalent about competitions. On a practical level, competitions are extremely expensive: entering a large competition can cost millions of dollars. More important, competitions oblige the architect to work in a vacuum. In later life, I. M. Pei refused to enter competitions, since he considered that the best architecture could emerge only from a considered dialogue between architect and client. Nevertheless, the public favors competitions, since they provide an opportunity for young talent to be recognized in a field that tends to privilege age and experience. Clients like competitions, since they provide an opportunity to choose between several designs — and several architects — while fund-raisers use competitions as a way to raise public interest in a building project. Everyone loves a horse race — except, perhaps, the horses.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 건축가와 의뢰인 사이의 숙고된 대화 = I. M. Pei가 최고의 건축이 나올 수 있는 유일한 방법이라 본 것 / ① 젊은 건축가들 사이의 대규모 공모전 / ② 현대 건축에 대한 비싼 투자 / ④ 건축 자재의 신중한 분석

❌ ② an expensive investment in modern buildings(현대 건축에 대한 비싼 투자): 투자 관련 내용은 본문에 없음. expensive는 공모전 비용을 설명할 뿐

✅ ③ a considered dialogue between architect and client(건축가와 의뢰인 간의 숙고된 대화): 'the best architecture could emerge only from ____' — I. M. Pei가 공모전을 거부한 이유. 최고의 건축은 건축가와 의뢰인의 대화에서만 나올 수 있다고 봄 ← 정답

❌ ④ a careful analysis of building materials(건축 자재의 신중한 분석): 자재 분석은 본문에 전혀 언급되지 않음
det.tip: emerge only from ____: '~에서만 나올 수 있다'의 출처. Pei의 신념 = 대화(dialogue)가 최선.

- tends to: ~하는 경향이 있다(3인칭 단수 — 선행사 field에 일치)
- privilege(동사): 우대하다, 특권을 부여하다
- age and experience: 나이와 경험(등위접속사 and로 연결)
det.tip: 'tends to privilege' = 우대하는 경향이 있다. tend to V + 목적어 구문. field가 단수이므로 tends.

questions.passage: Architects are ambivalent about competitions. On a practical level, competitions are extremely expensive: entering a large competition can cost millions of dollars. More important, competitions oblige the architect to work in a vacuum. In later life, I. M. Pei refused to enter competitions, since he considered that the best architecture could emerge only from a considered dialogue between architect and client. Nevertheless, the public favors competitions, since they provide an opportunity __________ in a field that tends to privilege age and experience. Clients like competitions, since they provide an opportunity to choose between several designs — and several architects — while fund-raisers use competitions as a way to raise public interest in a building project. Everyone loves a horse race — except, perhaps, the horses.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 아래 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
[조건] (1) for, young, talent, to, be, recognized을 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 대중이 공모전을 좋아하는 이유 중 하나: 젊은 인재가 인정받을 기회 — 'for young talent to be recognized'
det.analysis:
'they provide an opportunity for young talent to be recognized in a field that tends to privilege age and experience.' — opportunity 뒤의 for+의미상주어+to V 구문이 빈칸. 조건 단어 6개(for, young, talent, to, be, recognized) 모두 포함. 6단어 일치.

구문 분석:
- for young talent: 의미상 주어(젊은 인재가)
- to be recognized: to부정사 수동태(인정받기 위해/인정받을)
- an opportunity for A to V: A가 V할 기회
det.tip: 'for young talent to be recognized' = 젊은 인재가 인정받기 위한. for+의미상주어+to V 구문.
